en: The postcard features two sepia-toned photographs: the left image shows a large stone in a wooded area with runic inscriptions and a symbol of a hammer, as well as German words and dates. The right image shows a rocky excavation site or burial chamber amidst trees. The back of the postcard contains both handwritten and printed German text, including the word 'Hünengrab,' and information about the museum 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT.'
